newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares stable near record peak, US in focus.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares stable near record peak, US in focus.

text.p: Danish share prices closed virtually unchanged on Tuesday, with the index ending the day a whisker below Monday's all-time record closing peak and dealers seeing the market tracking Wall Street in the days to come.
A.P.Moeller, Tele Danmark and Sophus Berendsen were in focus, helping bolster the KFX index.
"Tele Danmark followed foreign telecommunications shares up with foreign buyers purchasing the stock," one dealer noted.
The KFX top-20 index closed 0.02 point lower at 170.38.
The KFX June future finished unchanged at 170.20 point with 170 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Moeller's D/S Svendborg closed 6,000 higher at 351,000, while twin D/S 1912 put on 2,759 to end up at 244,000.
Berendsen, bolstered by advances in London for partly-owned Rentokil, rose 2.1 crowns to 972.1, while Tele Danmark ended three crowns ahead at 349.
Overall turnover for the day was 1.079 billion crowns.
